roomNotes.entry: The original Anja body and a compatible separately sold shade are stocked. Confirm the complete lamp diameter and height against the small entrance table.
roomNotes.office: Stocked 84-inch Alora Brown Oak is an optional replacement for the unavailable Gael walnut desk; approve the wood sample and diagonal footprint. Stocked Nicola visitor chairs remain. Original Lucio task chair is special order; a lower-cost ergonomic chair can serve at move-in. Keep the north-wall TV build-out and printer cabinet.
roomNotes.media: The original Classic Cloud 3-piece configuration is stocked at 119 ×40 inches. A stocked Classic Cloud modular end ottoman is offered separately as a loose footstool; verify module compatibility if connecting it. Keep the 83-inch TV, custom walnut console, rear circulation and clear west-wall doors.
roomNotes.great: Original Modena Natural is special order with aNovember 3–9 quote, which may suit the move-in schedule. Stocked 8-foot Lugano Sand is a deeper, more plush alternative requiring a sit test. Current shelter-arm chairs,18-inch Enzo side table,48-inch Gael round table and 52-inch Rocco stone table offer stocked choices; select one coffee-table direction after tape-out.
roomNotes.kitchen: The original Morgan Brown Walnut stools are special order with a December estimate. Nicola Sand counter stools are a stocked alternative; confirm island height and quantity four before choosing.
roomNotes.dining: Nicola chairs replace the unavailable Enzo listing. Keep the measured extending-table direction; a fixed retail table has not been selected. The expensive Chana rug is an optional RH comparison, not the budget recommendation.
roomNotes.living: The old Cloud sofa listing is unavailable; the current 8-foot Classic Natural 2-cushion version is stocked, with only one unit selectable. It preserves the 96-inch width for the piano salon. The compact current shelter-arm chair and 40-inch Rocco table remain candidates; oversized Enzo rectangles were rejected.
roomNotes.sunroom: Six slim Nicola chairs are a stocked-configuration candidate; six-unit availability and tucking around the 72×34-inch table still need checking. Keep the existing six-seat rectangular table direction.
roomNotes.ownerbed: Stocked Lawson king best preserves the low neutral upholstered direction; Cloud is an oversized secondary comparison. Keep the floating bedside headwall and LED details. The original Gael dresser is unavailable; retain the fitted walnut dresser direction or source a measured lower-cost cabinet rather than substitute the tall 5-drawer Enzo merely for stock.
roomNotes.retreat: The old Modena chaise listing is unavailable; the current edition is special order. Optional stocked compact shelter-arm chairs with Petite Sand Cloud footstools provide a different two-person lounging arrangement. Stocked 18-inch Enzo Walnut side table fits the compact direction. Test comfort and tape out the entire arrangement around the bar route before choosing.
roomNotes.bed2: The low stocked Lawson queen is the closest neutral substitute. Keep the headboard against the stair-hall wall, the existing closet and the compact desk beside the window. The taller Italia bed is secondary, and only one unit was selectable.
roomNotes.bed3: A stocked 48-inch-high Lawson queen keeps the room calmer than the taller Italia alternative. Verify both bed and rug against the three windows and closet/entry routes. A lower-cost neutral wool rug remains preferable to premium Chana.
roomNotes.loft: Classic 119-inch Cloud is stock-verified; confirm the combined two-sofa quantity with the media room. Stocked 48-inch Enzo coffee table and 18-inch side table are candidates. Only a 48-inch Espresso Gael media console was stocked; it does not replace the large fitted console direction.
roomNotes.bed5: Bedroom 5 is unbuilt. Save these choices for later; do not buy furniture or oversized nightstands until the finished room and headwall are measured. Charcoal-channel bed stock is not confirmed; the tested charcoal velvet configuration is special order.
roomNotes.terrace: Original 72-inch Natural Teak Mesa dining table is stocked. Original 90-inch sofa and 48-inch Natural coffee table were not listed in stock;108-inch sofa and 60-inch table are conditional larger alternatives. Mesa lounge chairs, dining chairs and chaises have exactNovember–December quotes but no explicit stock label. Stocked Balmain lounge chairs, chaises and six quantity-checked slim Dove dining chairs provide alternatives; compare teak samples and measured clearances before mixing collections.
